Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Yet another question to which I assume the answer is yes.

If a vampire changes sect, does he lose titles which aren't
voting titles but were bestowed upon him by his own sect?
Camarilla Exemplary, Archon, Templar, etc?

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:


As an extension to this question, if the vampire does lose the title by
changing sect, does he/she gain the title/abilities back if he changes back to
the right sect?

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Not unless the effect (which is not a title) says so.
The ones you list are tied to neither sect nor clan
after being bestowed.
